[CR CR4206r1 for 38.331] Reason for change: During the Rel-16/17 MIMO work, there are a number of multi-TRP schemes (e.g. repetition schemes, HST-SFN schemes). Rel-16 single-DCI multi-TRP schemes Rel-16 scheme 1: SDM (no dedicated RRC) Rel-16 scheme 2a: fdmSchemeA Rel-16 scheme 2b: fdmSchemeB Rel-16 scheme 3: tdmSchemeA Rel-16 scheme 4: inter-slot TDM repetition (repetitionNumber in TDRA entry) Rel-17 SFN scheme Rel-17 sfnSchemeA: SFN Scheme 1 Rel-17 sfnSchemeB: TRP-based frequency offset pre-compensation RAN1 agreements made following restrictions that Rel-17 sfnSchemeA and sfnSchemeB are not simultaneously configured (i.e. support semi-static switching) with Rel-16 shemes. Agreement in RAN1#104-e For HST-SFN scenario: Support semi-static (RRC based) switching of scheme 1 (PDSCH) with 2a,

[3] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.306, sim=0.5612)
[CR CR1250r1 for 38.306] Reason for change: A new SIB17bis is introduced as a Rel-18 field and early implemented from Rel-17, see agreed CR R2-2406144. However, the capability is not updated. Currently, the capability of TRS in Rel-17 SIB17 in Idle and Inactive is defined as “Optional features without UE radio access capability parameters”. Since a new Rel-18 SIB17bis was introduced, as new capability for SIB17bis is needed. It is also necessary for RAN5 test defining, support of SIB17 and support of SIB17bis should be separately tested. Summary of change: The support of SIB17bis is defined as a separate optional feature without UE radio access capability parameters. Impact analysis Impacted 5G architecture options: NR SA Impacted functionality: TRS in Idle and Inactive Inter-operability: 

[4] (ran2_cr_chunks 36.331, sim=0.5546)
[CR CR4889 for 36.331] Reason for change: In Rel-9, the field of ue-ConfigRelease was added in inter-node message of HandoverPreparationInformation to indicate the RRC protocol release or version applicable for the current UE configuration. The motivation is to help target network to determine whether to apply the full configuration approach e.g. in case the release of current configuration is not supported by the target network. If this field is not present, the target assumes that the current UE configuration is based on the release 8 version of RRC protocol.
